candidates.review_note: Root the railway tree at the capital. A subtree can be solved independently because divisions move only toward the root; its output is the exact sorted arrival stream at its parent. Merge child streams with the local division available at day zero. At each day insert all arrived divisions into a priority heap, send at most the edge capacity, and deliver them one day later. Jump across empty waiting periods, preserving simultaneous arrivals before boarding. A unary node whose edge capacity is at least the child stream maximum simultaneous load has no queue: prepend its own day-zero availability and lazily add one to all arrival times using an offset, avoiding quadratic work on a long chain. This shortcut is conditional on a proved load bound, not a task-specific path case. The root reads final streams directly and its own division takes zero days.
